group.sql: select key, count(*) as n, sum(value) as total, min(value) as lo, max(value) as hi, count(distinct grp) as grps from facts group by key order by key

join.sql: select l.label, count(*) as n, sum(f.value * l.weight) as total, min(f.id) as first from facts f join labels l on f.id = l.id group by l.label order by l.label
